part.text:
Migration complete. The `pages` directory has been removed and everything is now in `app` using App Router APIs:

- `app/layout.tsx` replaces `_app` + `_document` (metadata API, `next/font`, shared layout)
- `app/page.tsx` uses `headers()` for the user agent and fetches posts server-side
- `app/blog/page.tsx` uses ISR via `revalidate`
- `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` uses `generateStaticParams`, `generateMetadata`, and `notFound()`
- `app/not-found.tsx` replaces `404.js`
- `app/error.tsx` replaces `_error.js`
- `app/api/posts/route.ts` and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` use Route Handlers
- Added shared types in `types/index.ts` and data helpers in `lib/data.ts`
- Converted `AppProvider` to TypeScript and added typed client button components

`npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` both pass.
